notes: Web demo funnel settings (itch.io / CrazyGames / Newgrounds / GitHub Pages). Read by web/src/engine/funnel.js.
steamUrl: set to https://store.steampowered.com/app/<numeric app id>/ once the Coming Soon page is live. Until then every Steam button says COMING SOON and links to fallbackUrl.
Every outbound Steam link gets ?utm_source=<portal>&utm_medium=web_demo&utm_campaign=<placement> so wishlists can be traced to the portal and the button.
ctaLockSec: how long the end-of-match Steam card is shown before RUN IT BACK / MENU unlock (the 'unskippable' CTA).
